title: Canonical compactification words and their strict composition maps
statement: Use the constant-tower site transports [def-sf-integral-compactification-site-transport], the strict semilinear operations with their proper/open mate and unital compositors [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization], and a compatible compactification triangle $t=(c_f,c_g,c_h,q,p)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Write $B_c=S_{p_c}J_{j_c}$ and let $W_c$ be the two-letter open-extension/direct-image word in [lem-sf-cbc-compact-support-composition-limit]. Define systemBeta from $B_gB_f$ to $B_h$ by applying $S_{p_g}$ to the intrinsic proper/open mate, then applying the open compositor and $j_fq=j_h$, then the direct-image compositor and $pp_g=p_h$. Define originalWord and originalBeta by exactly the same construction on the original strict constant-tower category, using its normalized gamma, jComp and rComp [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. Define wordTransport from originalWord through the exact site equivalence to the strict word of $W_c$ by directModel followed by the direct image of openModel. Finally define constantBeta on the small-model strict category by the inverse-equivalence counit, the inverse transports of the two input words, the image of originalBeta, the output-word transport, and the forward counit. These are actual derived strict-tower morphisms, before any finite evaluation, for the same compactification triangle.
